title: Comparing Human Phenotype Ontology releases highlights persistent gaps in prenatal gene-phenotype annotation: code and data

creators.name: Tran, Thai Huu Loc
creators.affiliation: Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Hong Hung Hospital, Tay Ninh, Viet Nam

creators.name: Tran, Nguyen Hoang Thi
creators.affiliation: Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Hong Hung Hospital, Tay Ninh, Viet Nam

description: Code, extracted data and archived public inputs that reproduce every number and figure of the study: prenatal imaging findings and source-reported causal genes of 335 fetuses from four published prenatal exome sequencing cohorts, coded as Human Phenotype Ontology terms and ranked with the 2020 and 2026 HPO releases, with an analysis of prenatal gene-phenotype annotation gaps.
